---
title: "Mangrove Structure in Placencia"
---

Mangrove field sampling and satellite-derived coverage data is presented here along with documentation to help you build related analyses.

## Where to start

- **[Sector Explorer](explorer.qmd)** — start here. Click a lagoon sector on the map to see its species mix, trunk diameter (DBH) and height distributions, and underlying tree-level data.
- [Sampling Points](sampling-points.qmd) — a station-by-station view of total biomass sampled in the field.
- [Field Sampling](field-sampling.qmd) and [Satellite Mapping](satellite-mapping.qmd) — background on how the field and mapping data were collected.
- [Vignettes](vignettes.qmd) — short, researcher-contributed explorations of the data.
